lines.text: You generated the shot five times. The blocking is still wrong.
Wind Comic gives you the other option — direct it.
Place your actors and the camera. The exact blocking becomes the prompt — and a layout sketch that locks composition.
Someone out of frame? Blocked by the person in front? You hear about it before you spend a cent generating.
Hate two seconds of an eight-second shot? Retake those two. The other six are byte-copied — not re-encoded, not degraded.
Around that: script, cast, storyboards, voices, lip-sync, final cut. Rerun any stage without redoing the rest.
And a publish gate that names the shots to fix — not a vague score.
Your keys, your engines. EDL, FCPXML and AAF from the same source as the film. Open source, MIT.

bgm.blob: Direct the shot — don't re-roll the dice
